class.name: kontrolem_ros2_control/KontrolemController
class.description: Kontrol'Em v2 runtime: a ros2_control controller that hosts any kontrolem_control::Controller plugin (LQR, QP task-space, ...), mapping joint state/command interfaces to the ROS-free control core, with a minimal supervisor acting on the controller's status().

class.name: kontrolem_ros2_control/FloatingStateProbe
class.description: M3 spike: claims the floating base's scalar <gpio> state interfaces + joint states, reassembles a manifold-correct State, and reports base height / CoM / quaternion norm. Read-only; tests non-joint state through ros2_control.
